channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: CM Naidu thanks Nitin Gadkari for improving National Highway network in Andhra
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has thanked Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari for his continuous support in improving the national highway network in the state.

item.title: HRW Flags Attacks on Hindus, Rising Violence Against Women in Bangladesh
item.description: The HRW stated that the interim government arbitrarily detained thousands of perceived political opponents and, in May, banned the Awami League.

item.title: Underground Rail Tunnel to Boost Trade, Tourism in Northeast
item.description: In a post on the social media platform X, CM Sarma said the ambitious project would cement India's strategic and economic links with the Northeast, a region long dependent on the narrow Siliguri Corridor, often referred to as the "Chicken's Neck", for surface connectivity.

item.title: Cyber fraud gang with international links busted in Bihar’s Madhubani, four arrested
item.description: During the operation, police recovered seven SIM boxes, 136 mobile phones and SIM cards, several electronic devices, and Rs 1.68 lakh in cash, along with other equipment used in cyber fraud.

item.title: India–EU FTA a Game Changer in Bilateral Ties, Says Jaishankar
item.description: Highlighting the growing partnership between India and the European Union (EU), External Affairs Minister (EAM) S. Jaishankar on Friday described the signing of the Free Trade Agreement (FTA) as a transformative milestone in bilateral ties while addressing the India-EU forum.

item.title: Aishwarya wishes ‘Babyyy-Papa’ Abhishek Bachchan on behalf of daughter Aaradhya on birthday
item.description: Bollywood actress Aishwarya Rai Bachchan has wished her husband, Abhishek Bachchan on his birthday on behalf of her daughter Aaradhya Bachchan.

item.title: Shabana Azmi calls herself a Russell Crowe admirer: ‘A Beautiful Mind continues to haunt me’
item.description: Veteran actress Shabana Azmi declared herself to be a Russell Crowe admirer through her latest social media post.

item.title: Freight train carrying hazardous materials derails in US Connecticut
item.description: A shelter-in-place order has been issued within a half-mile radius of the accident scene for a possible hazardous gas leak, according to a statement released by the Mansfield town government, Xinhua news agency reported.

item.title: Manoj Bajpayee says Ghooskhor Pandat is ‘not about any community’ amid title controversy
item.description: After filmmaker Neeraj Pandey, actor Manoj Bajpayee has also reacted to the ongoing controversy regarding the name of their forthcoming Netflix drama, "Ghooskhor Pandat".

item.title: Akshay Kumar reveals Dharam Ji used to be his favourite hero during the struggling days
item.description: The late legendary actor Dharmendra ruled not just the screen but also numerous hearts for several years.
